maria: Heads up — noticed a p99 spike after kernel v2.3 rollout on rtx-prod pool around 08:12 PT, mostly for short requests (<64 tokens)
infra-bot: deploy v2.3 -> 2026-03-18T08:11:52Z succeeded :white_check_mark:
liam: saw this on the dashboards; p50 ~45ms, p95 ~160ms but p99 jumps to ~1.1s for short-tail requests — big regression
sasha: I pulled a CPU/GPU flame + nvprof. KV-miss path shows ~550-700ms extra due to fallback kernel + host memcpy path
nate: confirmed in traces: when kv_hit=false we route to kernel_fallback_v1, do host memcpy, then hot-switch to kernel_v2 causing cold init penalty
maria: paste of a short trace snippet:
```
trace: req=abc123, seq=1, tokens=18, kv_hit=false, kernel=v2.3 -> fallback=v1, kv_miss_penalty=620ms
sched: max_wait_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=4096
```
liam: quick hypothesis — the batching delay (max_wait) is amplifying KV-miss tail because requests wait behind one slow KV-miss job and the wait accumulates
sasha: experiment idea: lower max_wait_ms for short-token paths and add small enqueue jitter to avoid synchronized batch formation spikes
nate: other idea: early-flush the batch if head-of-queue indicates kv_miss so the rest don't wait for the slow miss
maria: ran a short canary: set global max_wait_ms=4ms -> p99 for short requests dropped to ~520ms, but observed throughput -6% on the pool
liam: also tried max_batch_tokens=2048 in the same canary, throughput recovered to -3% and p99 ~480ms — looks promising
sasha: enabling random jitter on enqueue in [0..3ms] smoothed the sawtooth tail; p99 stayed stable over a 30m window
maria: tradeoff: more smaller microbatches -> slightly worse GPU kernel efficiency, need to quantify cost delta
nate: cost numbers from canary: tokens/sec down ~2.8%, GPU util down ~1.5% — seems acceptable to meet SLAs
liam: proposal: run a 24h A/B test
A) adaptive policy: if request.tokens < 64 -> max_wait_ms=4, max_batch_tokens=2048, enqueue_jitter=0..3ms
B) conservative global: max_wait_ms=6, max_batch_tokens=4096, early_flush_on_kv_miss=true
sasha: add metric hooks before rollout: kv_miss_rate, p99_short_requests, gpu_util, cost_rate, kernel_switch_count, avg_batch_size
maria: I'll schedule canary rollout to 10% traffic on the canary pool at 09:30 PT

nate: I'll own the postmortem notes and update perf dashboards with the experiment metrics
